## Task

`/audit-artifacts`: Shape, Voice, Truth, Proof.

Subject area: integration testing and static-analysis quality gates.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Story #86 and tasks #19 to #20 each match their template, meet the
      writing standard, hold at most 5 criteria, and carry no empty section
      or run log in Notes
